name: COSMOS
recent: Cosmos Technology 于 2026 年 10 月 19 日宣布拟以 1652 万令吉收购 Orisystems Opto 51% 股权，采用全股票交易；10 月 16 日获得 393 万令吉供应合约。此外，公司于 10 月 20 日召开第 7 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。
notable: 拟以 1652 万令吉收购 Orisystems Opto 51% 股权，采用全股票交易。
获得价值 393 万令吉的供应合约。
第 7 届常年股东大会所有决议获通过。
risks: 大股东 Dato' Foong Wei Kuong 于 11 月 10 日至 11 日申报权益变动。
大股东 Dato' Chong Toh Wee 于 10 月 15 日申报权益变动，同日 MSM International Limited 申报不再是大股东。
董事 Dato' Chong Toh Wee 于 10 月 15 日在场外增持 5,130,000 股（约 2%）。

recent_en: Cosmos Technology announced on 19 October 2026 a proposed acquisition of a 51% stake in Orisystems Opto for RM16.52 million via an all-share deal, and secured a RM3.93 million supply contract on 16 October. The company also held its 7th AGM on 20 October, with all resolutions passed.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of 51% stake in Orisystems Opto for RM16.52 million via all-share deal.
Secured a supply contract worth RM3.93 million.
All resolutions passed at the 7th AGM.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder Dato' Foong Wei Kuong reported changes in interest on 10-11 November.
Substantial shareholder Dato' Chong Toh Wee reported a change in interest on 15 October; MSM International Limited ceased to be a substantial shareholder on the same day.
Director Dato' Chong Toh Wee acquired 5,130,000 shares (about 2%) outside closed period on 15 October.
